# Bundled browser dependencies

- `stomp.umd.min.js`: @stomp/stompjs 7.2.0, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@stomp/stompjs@7.2.0/bundles/stomp.umd.min.js (Apache-2.0; STOMP-LICENSE).
